import sys

def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n = int(input_line)
    MOD = 1000000007
    
    mat = [[0]*(n+1) for _ in range(n+1)]
    sum_total = 0
    
    for i in range(n+1):
        mat[i][0] = 1
        if (i + 0) % 2 == 1:
            sum_total += mat[i][0]
            sum_total %= MOD
    
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        for j in range(i, n+1):
            mat[j][i] = (mat[j][i-1] + mat[j-1][i]) % MOD
            if (i + j) % 2 == 1:
                sum_total += mat[j][i]
                sum_total %= MOD
    
    print(sum_total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
